note: Small make, comprehensively wrong: every Isuzu diesel was recorded as petrol, including the whole 4J family that powers the D-Max and Trooper. Isuzu's codes separate cleanly — 4E, 4F, 4J, C223 and RZ4E are diesels; 4X, 4Z, 6VD1, G200Z and the GM-built LL8/LH6 are petrols. Isuzu's own oil is BESCO; the DPF-equipped RZ4E requires the low-SAPS BESCO CLEAN (JASO DH-2), while the pre-DPF units take a conventional 15W-40 that suits Tunisian temperatures. Capacities are family figures unless stated otherwise.

engines.source: RZ4E-TC 1.9 Ddi — D-Max Euro 6. Particulate filter fitted, so the low-SAPS BESCO CLEAN / JASO DH-2 grade is a requirement and no heavier alternative is offered.
4JH1-TC and 4JJ1-TC 3.0 common-rail — D-Max, Trooper. Recorded as petrol. Capacity is a family figure.
4JK1-TC 2.5 common-rail — D-Max. Part of the range was already recorded as diesel and part as petrol.
4JA1 2.5, 4JB1-T/TC 2.8 and 4JG2 3.1 indirect-injection diesels — Campo, Trooper, Elf. Pre-common-rail, no particulate filter; conventional 15W-40.
C223 / C223-T 2.2 diesel — Campo, Trooper. Recorded as petrol throughout.
4EC1 / 4EC1T 1.5 and 4EE1 1.7 diesels — Gemini. Recorded as petrol. Not to be confused with the 4XE1 petrol of the same displacement in the same model.
LL8 4.2 and LH6 5.3 — the GM engines in the Ascender. API SL/SM; capacity is a family figure.
6VD1 3.2 V6 petrol — Trooper. Capacity is a family figure.
4XC1 / 4XE1 / 4XF1 (Gemini, Impulse), 4ZC1 / 4ZD1 / 4ZE1 (Midi, Trooper) and G200Z (Campo) petrols. Pre-1998 designs; 10W-40 is the conventional grade and suits hot climates.
